title: Trader Diary: BTC at $79,485 and my leverage dreams
content:
💭 8 AM: “Just a tiny 2x long, easy profit.”
🚀 9 AM: “Why is my margin screaming louder than my coffee?”
📉 10 AM: “Okay, maybe I should’ve set a stop…"
lesson: Set your stop‑loss before you set your coffee; leverage loves to surprise.
question: Who else turned a 2x into a 2‑minute heart attack? Share your panic emojis 👇
